## What to build

Add `vowel_ratio(text: str) -> float` to `src/textkit/vowels.py`: `count_vowels(text)` divided by the number of letters in `text`, and 0.0 for text without letters.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `vowel_ratio("Hello World")` is 0.3.
- [ ] `vowel_ratio("123")` is 0.0.
- [ ] Tests in `tests/test_vowels.py`.
